exposure: Indication for surgery (related to decreased fertility or pelvic pain vs. suggesting normal fertility)
cohort: 460 women who underwent different laparoscopic procedures for a variety of indications in Jordan University Hospital, a tertiary referral hospital in Jordan, between January 2015 and September 2020
finding: The prevalence of endometriosis in this patient group was higher than that of the general population, and was significantly higher in women with lower numbers of pregnancies and Cesarean sections, and in those where the indication for surgery was related to decreased fertility or pelvic pain.
